signin.title: Sign in to your client portal
signin.sent: If this address has access, a sign-in link is on its way. Check your inbox.
signin.noOrg: Open the link in your invitation or sign-in email to reach your portal.
signin.ended: Your access to this portal has ended. If you think this is a mistake, contact the people you work with.

signin.linkInvalid: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.
signin.totpInvalid: That code did not work. Try again.
signin.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
signin.enrol: This portal asks for a second step. Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.

notice.failed: That did not work. Try again.

done.declined: Declined. The people you work with are told.
